walk.zh: 短腿踩雪，一步一个深坑。
walk.en: Stubby legs, one deep footprint per step.

walk.zh: 我用肚皮滑下这道雪坡。
walk.en: I slide down this snow slope on my belly.

walk.zh: 冰山那边有我的老窝。
walk.en: My old den lies past that iceberg.

walk.zh: 四只小脚，走起来晃得厉害。
walk.en: Four little feet, and I wobble with every step.

walk.zh: 背上这层白毛挡得住风雪。
walk.en: The white fur on my back keeps the blizzard out.

walk.zh: 冰角撞在树上，会留下印子。
walk.en: My ice horn leaves marks when I bump into trees.

walk.zh: 我一边走一边哼鲸歌。
walk.en: I hum a whale song while I waddle along.

walk.zh: 顺着雪水的气味找河。
walk.en: I follow the smell of meltwater to the river.

walk.zh: 冰原尽头，风更冷一些。
walk.en: At the edge of the ice field, the wind bites colder.

walk.zh: 走过霜草，肚皮被扎了一下。
walk.en: Frost grass poked my belly as I waddled past.

walk.zh: 我拖着小尾巴，慢慢挪。
walk.en: I drag my little tail and shuffle slowly forward.

walk.zh: 这个雪坑是我昨天挖的。
walk.en: I dug this snow pit yesterday afternoon.

idle.zh: 呼——一团白气从背上冒起。
idle.en: Hoo—a puff of white breath rises off my back.

idle.zh: 我把冰角靠在石头边歇着。
idle.en: I rest my ice horn against a rock.

idle.zh: 肚皮朝天，雪落在脸上。
idle.en: Belly up, snowflakes landing on my face.

idle.zh: 拿脚印当枕头，睡一小会。
idle.en: I nap with a footprint as my pillow.

idle.zh: 数一数今天撞了几次树。
idle.en: Counting how many trees I bumped today.

idle.zh: 远处冰山在响，像在叫我。
idle.en: The far iceberg creaks, as if calling me home.

idle.zh: 我舔了舔背上的盐霜。
idle.en: I lick the salt frost off my own back.

idle.zh: 尾巴拍雪，拍出一个坑。
idle.en: My tail slaps the snow into a small pit.

idle.zh: 太阳晒到冰角，开始滴水。
idle.en: Sun on my ice horn—it is starting to drip.

idle.zh: 太热了，我往洞里退半步。
idle.en: Too warm; I back half a step into my burrow.

idle.zh: 想起去年雪崩，我滚了三圈。
idle.en: I recall last year's avalanche; I rolled three times.

idle.zh: 谁在雪里埋了颗果子？
idle.en: Who buried a berry out here in the snow?

idle.zh: 冰角上结了新的霜。
idle.en: Fresh frost has formed on my ice horn.

idle.zh: 我用鼻子拱开一堆雪。
idle.en: I nudge a pile of snow aside with my snout.

look_player.zh: 你身上有股松木燃烧的气味。
look_player.en: You carry the smell of burning pine.

look_player.zh: 你站的位置，雪化得很快。
look_player.en: The snow melts fast where you are standing.

look_player.zh: 你的靴子比我的脚长多了。
look_player.en: Your boots are far longer than my feet.
Are you one of those who come for my horn?
I am not afraid; I have four legs.
Don't wave that ball at me; I haven't decided.
You just crushed my sliding track.

look_player.zh: 蹲下来，我的眼睛在低处。
look_player.en: Crouch down; my eyes are way down here.

look_player.zh: 你呼出的气也是白色的。
look_player.en: Your breath comes out white too.
We don't get many guests on this mountain.
Are you counting my short little legs?

look_player.zh: 你的影子压在雪上，好重。
look_player.en: Your shadow lies heavy on the snow.

look_player.zh: 我闻到你口袋里的精灵球。
look_player.en: I can smell the Poké Ball in your pocket.

look_player.zh: 别站在我滑下来的路上。
look_player.en: Don't stand where I'm about to slide down.

tempted.zh: 那颗果子在雪里冻得发亮。
tempted.en: That berry glistens, frozen in the snow.
Is it sweet or sour?
I'll just lick it once; that doesn't count.

tempted.zh: 冰镇过的果实最合我胃口。
tempted.en: Chilled berries suit my stomach best.

tempted.zh: 你手心里的东西在冒热气。
tempted.en: Whatever's in your palm is steaming.

tempted.zh: 我用冰角跟你换那颗果子。
tempted.en: I'll trade you my ice horn for that berry.
Just one bite, I promise.

tempted.zh: 闻着像春天融雪的味道。
tempted.en: It smells like spring meltwater.

tempted.zh: 我肚子叫得比雪崩还响。
tempted.en: My stomach rumbles louder than an avalanche.
Step back a bit; I bite carelessly.

collide.en: My ice horn bumped you first.
Short legs, no brakes—sorry about that.
You're so hard I bounced right off.
We knocked a ring of snow loose.

collide.zh: 让让，我滑行时拐不了弯。
collide.en: Move aside—I can't turn while sliding.
You stepped on my tail; it's short.

collide.zh: 撞一下不疼吧？我垫了雪。
collide.en: Did that hurt? I was standing in snow.
My back is like a round smooth stone.
The snow is slick; my feet won't stop.
I stepped left, and so did you.

mate.zh: 你看见另一只走鲸了吗？
mate.en: Have you seen another Cetoddle nearby?

mate.zh: 我想把冰角擦得更亮些。
mate.en: I want to polish my ice horn brighter.

mate.zh: 这洞是我挖的，够两只睡。
mate.en: I dug this burrow; it fits two of us.

mate.zh: 她滑得比我稳，我愿意等。
mate.en: She slides steadier than me; I can wait.

mate.zh: 我哼一句鲸歌，看她回不回。
mate.en: I hum a whale song and wait for an answer.

mate.zh: 雪地上并排两串脚印。
mate.en: Two rows of footprints side by side in snow.

mate.zh: 把最圆的雪球滚到她脚边。
mate.en: I roll the roundest snowball to her feet.

mate.zh: 我的尾巴小，摇起来很费劲。
mate.en: My tail is tiny; wagging it takes effort.

mate.zh: 她要是来了，我就不乱撞树。
mate.en: If she comes, I'll stop bumping into trees.

mate.zh: 天冷的时候，挤一挤更暖和。
mate.en: In cold weather, huddling together is warmer.

pickup.en: There is a small stone inside this ice.

pickup.zh: 我把果子塞进背上的毛里。
pickup.en: I tuck the berry into the fur on my back.
Someone dropped a little iron scrap.
My ice horn snagged a scrap of cloth.
I bury it in the snow to keep it safe.

pickup.zh: 这石头圆得像我的肚皮。
pickup.en: This stone is as round as my belly.

pickup.zh: 一件亮东西，能换多少果子？
pickup.en: Something shiny—how many berries is it worth?
I bit it; it's just wood.

pickup.zh: 捡到的都堆在我的窝口。
pickup.en: Everything I find piles up at my den's mouth.
This one's hot; I wrap it in snow.

target_acquire.en: Ice horn aimed—now is the moment.

target_acquire.zh: 那个影子在动，我看见了。
target_acquire.en: That shadow moved; I saw it.

target_acquire.zh: 雪地会记住你踩下的坑。
target_acquire.en: The snow remembers the holes you leave.
Don't measure my speed by looking.
I have more stamina than I look.
You're blocking my way back to the den.
I won't blink first.
The ice field is my home ground.
Come on, try my headbutt.

target_acquire.zh: 上次撞飞我的不是你吧？
target_acquire.en: You're not the one who knocked me flying, are you?

targeting.en: The moment you stop, I'll charge.
Your feet are sinking into the snow.

targeting.zh: 我绕着圈子，找你的侧面。
targeting.en: I circle, looking for your open side.
I'm panting hard, but not backing off.
My horn is glowing—do you see it?
You're tired too; we're the same.
One step, then another, closing in.
If I miss, I'll just charge again.
I'm not fast; I'm just very heavy.
Don't blink; here I come.

melee_attack.en: Ice horn forward, scattering snow!

melee_attack.zh: 这一下顶在你的膝盖上。
melee_attack.en: This one lands on your knee.
I throw my whole body at you.

melee_attack.zh: 头槌之后，我原地转半圈。
melee_attack.en: After the headbutt, I spin half a turn.
My belly bounces you back two steps.

melee_attack.zh: 雪被掀起来，挡住了视线。
melee_attack.en: Snow kicks up and hides your sight.
A flick of my tail—not hard.

melee_attack.zh: 我咬着你的袖子往雪里拖。
melee_attack.en: I drag your sleeve down into the snow.
My horn scrapes past, leaving a white line.
When I land, the snow surface cracks.

spawn.en: A hole opens in the snow and up I come.

spawn.zh: 冰原上多了一串短腿印。
spawn.en: A new string of short footprints on the ice.

spawn.zh: 这山头的雪，比记忆里厚。
spawn.en: This peak's snow is deeper than I remember.

spawn.zh: 我从山洞一路滚下来的。
spawn.en: I rolled all the way down from the cave.

spawn.zh: 冷的空气钻进我的背毛。
spawn.en: Cold air works its way into my back fur.
I look up at a sky I don't know.
First the river, then something to eat.

spawn.zh: 这里的雪闻起来不一样。
spawn.en: The snow here smells different.

spawn.zh: 我抖了抖背，雪落了一地。
spawn.en: I shake my back and snow falls everywhere.

spawn.zh: 今年的第一场雪，我赶上了。
spawn.en: I made it for the first snow of the year.

spawn.zh: 我叫声很低，像风穿过缝。
spawn.en: My call is low, like wind through a crack.

spawn.zh: 有人的气味，也有火的气味。
spawn.en: Smell of people, and smell of fire.

generic.en: My ice horn took the hit—that stings.
My white fur is covered in dust.
I flatten myself against the snow.
I back off two steps, legs trembling.
Thick hide, but it still hurts.

generic.zh: 我的叫声变成短促的哼。
generic.en: My call shrinks to a short grunt.
Not the back—that's my softest place.
I crouch and tuck my horn away.
I trample the snow under my feet.
One more of those and I run.

fire.en: Fire on my ice horn—it drips and hisses.

fall.zh: 从坡上滚下去，头有点晕。
fall.en: Rolling down the slope leaves me dizzy.

drown.zh: 水没到脖子，我蹬着四条腿。
drown.en: Water at my neck; all four legs kick.

explosion.en: The blast flips me over into the snow.

projectile.zh: 一支箭插在我的背上毛里。
projectile.en: An arrow sticks in the fur on my back.

magic.zh: 紫色的光让我背毛立起来。
magic.en: Violet light makes my back fur stand up.

starvation.zh: 三天没吃，肚皮贴到骨头。
starvation.en: Three days without food; my belly feels hollow.

lightning.zh: 雷打在冰角上，我整个人亮了。
lightning.en: Lightning strikes my horn; I light up all over.

void.zh: 脚下没有雪，也没有声音。
void.en: No snow under me, and no sound at all.

walk.zh: 我不走路，我飘着过去。
walk.en: I don't walk; I drift across the floor.

walk.zh: 火光晃一下，影子就换个位置。
walk.en: My flame flickers and the shadow moves.

walk.zh: 走廊的尽头，我停了一停。
walk.en: At the end of the corridor I pause.

walk.zh: 我的六簇火，照亮了这一片。
walk.en: My six flames light this whole hall.

walk.zh: 地板在响，我却没碰过它。
walk.en: The floorboards creak, though I never touch them.

walk.zh: 我沿着墙走，墙比我更冷。
walk.en: I travel along the wall; the wall is colder.

walk.zh: 灯罩摇着，像在找什么。
walk.en: My shades sway as if searching for something.

walk.zh: 我离地半尺，影子贴在地上。
walk.en: Half a foot up, my shadow drags on the floor.

walk.zh: 穿过门框时，我收了一下火。
walk.en: Passing the doorframe, I draw my flames in.

walk.zh: 我走过的地方，蜡烛都灭了。
walk.en: Candles go out wherever I pass.

walk.zh: 老宅的楼梯，一共十三级。
walk.en: This old house has thirteen stairs.

walk.zh: 我跟着风，飘上二楼。
walk.en: I follow a draft up to the second floor.

idle.zh: 火光安静地烧着，没有烟。
idle.en: The flame burns quietly, without smoke.

idle.zh: 我数着屋里还有几盏灯。
idle.en: I count how many lamps still burn here.

idle.zh: 有人路过，我就暗下去一点。
idle.en: When someone passes, I dim a little.

idle.zh: 我的火是冷的，摸不到热。
idle.en: My fire is cold; it gives no heat.

idle.zh: 我悬在梁下，等夜更深。
idle.en: I hang beneath the beam, waiting for deeper night.

idle.zh: 火苗记得每一张看过的脸。
idle.en: My flames remember every face they've seen.

idle.zh: 灰落在我的臂上，我不擦。
idle.en: Ash settles on my arms; I leave it.

idle.zh: 这屋子空了三十年。
idle.en: This house has been empty thirty years.

idle.zh: 我听见墙里有东西在爬。
idle.en: Something is crawling inside the wall.

idle.zh: 我把自己调暗，像一盏坏灯。
idle.en: I dim myself to look like a broken lamp.

idle.zh: 火焰的顶端，蓝得发白。
idle.en: The tips of my flames are white-blue.

idle.zh: 我哼一支没有词的调子。
idle.en: I hum a tune that has no words.

idle.zh: 窗玻璃上映出两个我。
idle.en: The window shows two of me.

idle.zh: 我又想起那些走不掉的魂。
idle.en: I think again of souls that could not leave.

look_player.en: The fire in you burns warmer than mine.
Why do you dare stand here?
My light falls across your face.

look_player.zh: 你看得太久了，眼睛发直。
look_player.en: You've stared too long; your eyes go blank.

look_player.zh: 你还提着灯吗？不需要了。
look_player.en: Still carrying a lantern? You won't need it.
I know the iron on your belt.
Do you want to count my flames?

look_player.zh: 退一步，你的影子在我脚下。
look_player.en: Step back—your shadow is under my feet.
My flame's shape is in your eyes.

look_player.zh: 你这身衣服，不像这屋子的人。
look_player.en: Those clothes don't belong to this house.

look_player.zh: 我照得见你，你看不见我。
look_player.en: I can see you; you cannot see me.
Is anyone waiting for you to come back?
Your breathing has slowed down.
Don't come closer; the flame will remember you.

tempted.zh: 你手里的灯，火苗跳得真好看。
tempted.en: The flame in your lamp dances beautifully.

tempted.zh: 那点火星，够我添一簇火。
tempted.en: That spark would feed one of my flames.

tempted.zh: 是煤吗？煤烧起来很老实。
tempted.en: Is that coal? Coal burns so honestly.
I smell lamp oil on you.
Hold that fire a little higher.

tempted.zh: 木柴的干湿度，我一闻就知道。
tempted.en: One sniff tells me if the wood is dry.
Leave the half-burned candle to me.
I don't eat; I only want to burn.
Let me taste that patch of light.

tempted.zh: 火焰凑近时，我安静下来。
tempted.en: When the flame comes near, I go quiet.

collide.zh: 你穿过我的火，打了个寒战。
collide.en: You pass through my fire and shiver.

collide.zh: 我碰到你，火苗偏了一下。
collide.en: I brush you and my flames tilt.

collide.zh: 铁臂碰到你肩膀，响了一声。
collide.en: My iron arm meets your shoulder with a clink.

collide.zh: 别撞我的灯罩，会晃很久。
collide.en: Don't bump my shades; they sway for hours.
You have weight; I barely have any.

collide.zh: 我退开半尺，火却贴过去。
collide.en: I back off a foot; my flames lean in.
The air between us is cold.
Your shoulder felt a sudden chill, didn't it?

collide.zh: 我绕开你，铁链响了一声。
collide.en: I drift around you; my chain clinks once.

collide.zh: 别用剑碰我，我讨厌铁锈。
collide.en: Don't touch me with that blade; I hate rust.

mate.zh: 另一盏灯，也在等一个影子。
mate.en: Another chandelier is also waiting for a shadow.

mate.zh: 两团火靠近，会烧得更亮。
mate.en: Two flames close together burn brighter.

mate.zh: 我想把最蓝的那簇留给她。
mate.en: I'll keep my bluest flame for her.

mate.zh: 我们不用说话，火会传意。
mate.en: We need no words; flames carry meaning.

mate.zh: 她飘过的走廊，灯全灭了。
mate.en: Every lamp goes out in the hall she drifts through.

mate.zh: 两盏灯并排挂在梁下。
mate.en: Two chandeliers hang side by side on the beam.

mate.zh: 我把我的一半光分过去。
mate.en: I hand over half of my light.

mate.zh: 幽灵也会有想留下的地方。
mate.en: Even ghosts find a place they want to stay.

mate.zh: 她的火是紫色的，很好看。
mate.en: Her flames are purple; they are beautiful.

mate.zh: 一起烧到天亮吧。
mate.en: Let us burn together until dawn.

pickup.zh: 一枚旧蜡烛头，我收下了。
pickup.en: An old candle stub—I'll keep it.

pickup.zh: 这块铁片，是从灯架上掉的。
pickup.en: This iron piece fell from a lamp frame.

pickup.zh: 我把火苗移过去，照亮它。
pickup.en: I move a flame closer to see it.

pickup.zh: 纸片上的字被烧掉一半。
pickup.en: Half the writing on this paper is burned away.
Whose keyring is this, left behind?
This glass bead holds light; I like it.

pickup.zh: 我把东西放在最高的柜顶。
pickup.en: I set it on top of the tallest cabinet.
A pocket watch, burned black.

pickup.zh: 我拿着它，火就旺了一点。
pickup.en: Holding it, my fire grows a little.

pickup.zh: 旧屋里的东西，都归我照看。
pickup.en: Everything in this old house is mine to watch.

target_acquire.zh: 你的影子刚刚动了一下。
target_acquire.en: Your shadow just moved.
I've chosen you; don't look back.
My flames begin to lean down toward you.
In this house, you can't outrun me.

target_acquire.zh: 我听见你的心跳变快了。
target_acquire.en: I hear your heartbeat quicken.

target_acquire.zh: 四十五级以后，我不再躲。
target_acquire.en: Past level forty-five, I stop hiding.
My fire can tell the living from the rest.
My shades open like a black flower.
You stepped inside the circle I drew.

target_acquire.zh: 就让这盏灯为你亮着吧。
target_acquire.en: Let this lamp burn for you.

targeting.en: I count to three, then the fire falls.

targeting.zh: 你退到墙边，墙不让你走。
targeting.en: You back to the wall, and it holds you.
Blue flame first, purple right behind.
I cast one more shadow than you.
Looking up won't help; the fire is low.

targeting.zh: 火在绕圈，慢得像在哄你。
targeting.en: The flames circle slowly, as if coaxing you.
You step back; I close a foot of space.

targeting.zh: 这盏灯只烧该烧的东西。
targeting.en: This lamp burns only what it should.

targeting.zh: 你的影子已经站在我这边了。
targeting.en: Your shadow already stands on my side.
The last one—I'll be gentle.

melee_attack.zh: 火焰卷过去，热得没有温度。
melee_attack.en: Flames sweep over, hot without any heat.
My iron arm comes down as the shades spin.
I burn your shadow with blue fire.
A tongue of flame licks your armor's edge.
This flame takes strength, not skin.

melee_attack.zh: 我撞过去，你退到门框上。
melee_attack.en: I strike, and you stagger into the doorframe.
Purple fire presses against your back.
The pointed shade leaves a thin line.
My fire dies for half a second, then returns.

melee_attack.zh: 我没有血，你也没有退路。
melee_attack.en: I have no blood, and you have no way out.

spawn.en: A new chandelier hangs from the ceiling.
The room's temperature suddenly drops.

spawn.zh: 阁楼上，四十五级的火亮了。
spawn.en: A level forty-five flame lights the attic.

spawn.zh: 蜡烛自己一根一根地着了。
spawn.en: Candles light themselves, one by one.
I take shape out of the darkness.

spawn.zh: 这盏灯，三十年前就挂在这里。
spawn.en: This lamp hung here thirty years ago.

spawn.zh: 门自己关上了，风没有动。
spawn.en: The door shuts by itself; no wind moves.
When I open my eyes, the fire lights first.
The old house has a master again.
Dust turns in my light for a long while.

spawn.zh: 我听见有人在楼上走动。
spawn.en: I hear someone walking upstairs.

spawn.zh: 我的火在墙上投出六个影子。
spawn.en: My flames cast six shadows on the wall.

generic.en: A hairline crack splits my shade.

generic.zh: 我的火暗下去，又撑起来。
generic.en: My flame gutters low, then steadies.

generic.zh: 这一下，震掉了几点火星。
generic.en: That blow shakes a few embers loose.

generic.zh: 铁链在响，我不喜欢这声音。
generic.en: My chain rattles; I dislike that sound.

generic.zh: 光晃得厉害，我抓不住形状。
generic.en: My light wavers; I can't hold my shape.
My fire remembers whoever strikes me.

generic.zh: 我退到阴影里，灭了一半。
generic.en: I retreat into shadow, half extinguished.

generic.zh: 有点疼，像熄灭前的爆响。
generic.en: It stings, like the pop before a flame dies.

generic.zh: 我的火往内收，护住中心。
generic.en: My flames draw inward, guarding the core.
This house will remember you for me.

fire.zh: 火焰对火焰，我们互相烧。
fire.en: Flame against flame—we burn each other.

fall.zh: 我从梁上掉下去，火散了一路。
fall.en: I fall from the beam, flames scattering along the way.

drown.zh: 水浇上来，我的火发出嘶声。
drown.en: Water hits me; my fire hisses out.

explosion.zh: 气浪把灯罩掀开了一瞬。
explosion.en: The blast flips my shades open for a heartbeat.

projectile.zh: 箭穿过我的火，落在身后。
projectile.en: The arrow passes through my fire and lands behind.

magic.zh: 符文的冷，比我的火更冷。
magic.en: The runes' chill is colder than my fire.

starvation.zh: 没有火可以吃，我越来越淡。
starvation.en: No fire to feed on; I grow fainter.

lightning.zh: 雷光把我的火压成一粒。
lightning.en: The lightning flattens my flame to a single spark.

void.zh: 这里的黑，连我的火也不敢亮。
void.en: The dark here is too deep even for my flame.

walk.zh: 蛋在袋子里晃，我走慢一点。
walk.en: The egg bounces in my pouch; I walk slower.

walk.zh: 草地软，脚踩上去没声音。
walk.en: The grass is soft; my steps make no sound.

walk.zh: 我要在天黑前赶回窝。
walk.en: I want to reach my nest before dark.

walk.zh: 这一带有草药的味道。
walk.en: There's a smell of healing herbs around here.

walk.zh: 我抱着蛋，只能小步快走。
walk.en: Holding my egg, I can only take small steps.

walk.zh: 三根头发被风吹得乱晃。
walk.en: Wind tosses the three strands of my hair.

walk.zh: 我沿着溪水边绕过去。
walk.en: I skirt along the edge of the stream.

walk.zh: 有谁受伤了，我得快些。
walk.en: Someone's hurt; I need to hurry.

walk.zh: 走久了，蛋会暖一点。
walk.en: After a long walk, the egg grows warmer.

walk.zh: 我踏过一地野花，没踩坏。
walk.en: I cross a field of wildflowers without crushing them.

walk.zh: 前面的村子，我认得路。
walk.en: I know the road to the village ahead.

walk.zh: 我的尾巴在后面一摆一摆。
walk.en: My tail sways behind me as I go.

idle.zh: 我把蛋抱出来，晒晒太阳。
idle.en: I take the egg out to sit in the sun.

idle.zh: 数一数今天帮了几个人。
idle.en: Counting how many I helped today.

idle.zh: 草地上的花，开得刚刚好。
idle.en: The flowers on this grass are just right.

idle.zh: 我用短手理了理胸前的毛。
idle.en: My short arms smooth the fur on my chest.

idle.zh: 蛋贴在肚子上，暖暖的。
idle.en: The egg rests warm against my belly.

idle.zh: 有点困，但我不能睡。
idle.en: I'm sleepy, but I shouldn't sleep.

idle.zh: 远处有人在咳嗽。
idle.en: Someone is coughing in the distance.

idle.zh: 我慢慢转了个圈，看看四周。
idle.en: I turn slowly and look all around.

idle.zh: 这枚蛋，还没有裂痕。
idle.en: This egg still has no crack on it.

idle.zh: 我坐下的样子，像一团云。
idle.en: Sitting down, I look like a cloud.

idle.zh: 听说我出现的地方会变好。
idle.en: They say places I visit turn out better.

idle.zh: 蚂蚁爬上我的脚，我没动。
idle.en: An ant climbs my foot; I stay still.

idle.zh: 我给蛋讲今天的事。
idle.en: I tell the egg about my day.

idle.zh: 太阳往西挪，我该动了。
idle.en: The sun is moving west; time to go.

look_player.en: Your hands are shaking—are you hurt?
Let me look at that wound.
I have an egg here; take a share.
Your face is paler than the grass.
Crouch down; I can't quite reach you.

look_player.zh: 你不像坏人，我猜得出来。
look_player.en: You don't look cruel; I can usually tell.

look_player.zh: 你也是来草地找什么的吗？
look_player.en: Are you also looking for something in the grass?
Don't reach into my pouch.

look_player.zh: 你的靴底沾了泥和草籽。
look_player.en: Mud and grass seed cling to your boots.

look_player.zh: 我很少遇见人，你运气好。
look_player.en: I rarely meet people; you're lucky.

look_player.zh: 你笑的时候，我放心一点。
look_player.en: When you smile, I relax a little.
I smell medicine on you; you were hurt.

look_player.zh: 站近些，让我看清你的眼睛。
look_player.en: Come closer so I can see your eyes.

look_player.zh: 你愿意帮我抱一下蛋吗？
look_player.en: Would you hold my egg for a moment?

tempted.en: That berry smells very sweet.

tempted.zh: 我一天要走很远，得吃点。
tempted.en: I walk far each day, so I need to eat.

tempted.zh: 你放下的东西，我先闻闻。
tempted.en: I sniff what you set down first.
Just give me half of it.
I could trade you an egg for that.

tempted.zh: 饿的时候，我走得特别慢。
tempted.en: When hungry, I walk especially slowly.

tempted.zh: 这味道像春天的第一茬草。
tempted.en: It smells like the first grass of spring.

tempted.zh: 我吃一点点，留点给路上。
tempted.en: I'll eat a little and save some for the road.

tempted.zh: 你的手心好暖，我不急着吃。
tempted.en: Your palm is warm; I'm in no hurry.
That one's overripe; it's about to fall.

collide.en: I'm soft; that bump can't hurt much.
Sorry—I'm too round for this path.
The egg rattled once in my pouch.
I step aside to let you pass first.
Bumping me feels like bumping a pillow.
I steady myself on your arm.
Don't press—the egg in my pouch bruises.
I go around you, three extra steps.

collide.zh: 尾巴一甩，蹭到你的小腿。
collide.en: My tail swings and brushes your calf.
Neither of us is hurt—good.

mate.zh: 另一只吉利蛋，在溪对岸。
mate.en: Another Chansey is across the stream.

mate.zh: 我想把蛋给她看。
mate.en: I want to show her my egg.

mate.zh: 我们两个一起，能照顾更多。
mate.en: Together, we could care for more.

mate.zh: 她的袋子鼓鼓的，很好看。
mate.en: Her pouch is nicely full; it's a good sign.

mate.zh: 我用尾巴碰了碰她的尾巴。
mate.en: I touch my tail lightly to hers.

mate.zh: 草地这么大，够我们走。
mate.en: This meadow is big enough for both of us.

mate.zh: 我把最圆的蛋留给她。
mate.en: I keep my roundest egg for her.

mate.zh: 她不说话，只是靠过来。
mate.en: She says nothing, just leans closer.

mate.zh: 两只吉利蛋挤在一丛花里。
mate.en: Two Chansey squeezed into one clump of flowers.

mate.zh: 天黑前，我们一起回窝。
mate.en: Before dark, we head home together.

pickup.en: A healing herb—I know this one.
This berry still has dew on it.

pickup.zh: 我把东西放进袋子的侧面。
pickup.en: I tuck it into the side of my pouch.
Someone dropped half a loaf of bread.
This cloth will do for wrapping the egg.
That stone is too heavy for my arms.

pickup.zh: 我把散落的草籽收起来。
pickup.en: I gather up the scattered grass seeds.

pickup.zh: 这枚蛋不是我的，得还回去。
pickup.en: This egg isn't mine; it must go back.

pickup.zh: 亮亮的东西，我留给别人。
pickup.en: Something shiny—I'll leave it for someone.
Carrying it, I walk even slower.

target_acquire.zh: 我不喜欢打架，但别过来。
target_acquire.en: I don't like fighting, but stay back.
The egg is with me; forget it.
I'm standing in the middle of this path.
Back off, or I'll bump you with my whole body.
I shield my pouch and step back slowly.

target_acquire.zh: 草地上的东西，我都要护。
target_acquire.en: Everything on this meadow is mine to protect.

target_acquire.zh: 我体格结实，你别浪费力气。
target_acquire.en: My body's sturdy; don't waste your strength.

target_acquire.zh: 你伤了人，我就不会客气。
target_acquire.en: You hurt someone; I won't be gentle.
I'm standing here, and I won't move.
You'll have to get past me first.

targeting.zh: 你每走一步，我都听得见。
targeting.en: I can hear each step you take.
If you must hit someone, hit me.
I shift the egg behind me.
I won't run; it wouldn't help anyway.

targeting.zh: 你抬手的时候，我看见了。
targeting.en: I saw it when you raised your hand.
My breathing is still steady.
I can take this one.
Don't push me; I'm stronger than I look.
I take one step forward, just one.

targeting.zh: 草被踩平了，我们站在这里。
targeting.en: The grass is flattened; here we stand.

melee_attack.en: I throw my whole round body at you.
A light slap, yet you step back.
My tail swings through, trailing grass.

melee_attack.zh: 我顶住你，不让你靠近蛋。
melee_attack.en: I push against you, keeping you from the egg.

melee_attack.zh: 我撞一下，就退回来护蛋。
melee_attack.en: I bump once, then retreat to guard my egg.
This one is for the egg I'm guarding.

melee_attack.zh: 我的力气，都用在护蛋上。
melee_attack.en: All my strength goes into guarding this egg.

melee_attack.zh: 你被弹开半步，我喘了口气。
melee_attack.en: You're knocked back half a step; I catch my breath.

melee_attack.zh: 我踩下去，草地陷了一块。
melee_attack.en: My step sinks a patch of grass.
That's enough; don't come nearer.

spawn.en: I rise up out of the tall grass.

spawn.zh: 这片草地，今天多了个影子。
spawn.en: This meadow has one more shadow today.

spawn.zh: 十五级的我，胆子还不大。
spawn.en: At level fifteen, I'm still easily frightened.
Dew has soaked my feet.

spawn.zh: 我抱紧袋子，先看看四周。
spawn.en: I hug my pouch and look around first.
I smelled the flowers from far away.
Someone has lit a fire near here.
I step slowly out of the brush.
Today I want to be of help to someone.
The grass is tall; I stand on my toes.
I hear someone crying out in pain.
I'm here now; don't rush.

generic.en: I curl around the egg and shield it first.
It hurts, but I hold back the cry.
A small tuft of my fur is pulled loose.
I sit down and catch my breath.
That one landed on my shoulder, heavy.
I'll count it as endurance training.
Not on the side where the pouch is.
I back away and hide the egg in the grass.

generic.zh: 痛会过去，我见过很多次。
generic.en: Pain passes; I've seen it many times.
Are you finished? I'd like to sit down.

fire.en: Fire singes my fur; the smell is awful.

fall.zh: 摔在草上，还好土是软的。
fall.en: I land in the grass—thankfully the soil is soft.

drown.en: Water fills my nose; I flail about.

explosion.zh: 一声巨响，我抱着蛋趴下。
explosion.en: A blast rings out; I lie flat over the egg.

magic.zh: 光打在身上，毛都竖起来。
magic.en: Light hits me and my fur stands on end.

starvation.en: My stomach is empty; the egg is still warm.

lightning.zh: 雷落在旁边，我抖成一团。
lightning.en: Lightning strikes nearby; I shake into a ball.

void.zh: 这里没有草，我找不到路。
void.en: No grass here; I can't find my way.

walk.zh: 盔甲太大了，我走路哐当响。
walk.en: The armor's too big; I clank when I walk.

walk.zh: 我踩着灰，留下小小的脚印。
walk.en: I tread on ash, leaving tiny footprints.

walk.zh: 这身铁是我捡来的。
walk.en: I found this iron shell myself.

walk.zh: 面罩歪了，我抬手扶正。
walk.en: My visor slipped; I push it straight.

walk.zh: 火焰从盔缝里漏出来。
walk.en: Flames leak through the seams of my armor.

walk.zh: 我走得慢，但不会停。
walk.en: I walk slowly, but I don't stop.

walk.zh: 前面是烧过的村子。
walk.en: A burned village lies ahead.

walk.zh: 小火星跟着我一路飘。
walk.en: Little sparks drift along behind me.

walk.zh: 我的脚把灰踩成一条路。
walk.en: My feet press the ash into a path.

walk.zh: 铁片在肩上晃，很响。
walk.en: A plate wobbles on my shoulder, loudly.

walk.zh: 我要去找更大的甲。
walk.en: I'm going to find a bigger shell.

walk.zh: 一步一步，总能走到。
walk.en: Step by step, I'll get there eventually.

idle.zh: 我蹲在灰里，火慢慢烧。
idle.en: I crouch in the ash, my fire burning low.

idle.zh: 我用手指拨了拨余烬。
idle.en: I poke the embers with one finger.

idle.zh: 这顶头盔，是别人留下的。
idle.en: Someone left this helmet behind.

idle.zh: 火不敢太大，怕烧到甲。
idle.en: I keep my fire small so it won't scorch the armor.

idle.zh: 我盯着远处的火光看。
idle.en: I stare at a distant fire.

idle.zh: 面罩里只有两点红光。
idle.en: Only two red glows show behind my visor.

idle.zh: 我数身上的凹痕，一共七处。
idle.en: I count the dents on me: seven.

idle.zh: 夜里风大，火苗缩起来。
idle.en: The night wind rises; my flame shrinks.

idle.zh: 我把铁片擦得亮了一点。
idle.en: I polish one iron plate a little brighter.

idle.zh: 有人在等我变强吗？
idle.en: Is anyone waiting for me to grow strong?

idle.zh: 灰落进盔缝，我抖了抖。
idle.en: Ash falls into my seams; I shake it out.

idle.zh: 我的影子比我还小。
idle.en: My shadow is even smaller than I am.

idle.zh: 我试了试挥剑的姿势。
idle.en: I practice the stance of holding a blade.

idle.zh: 火苗跳了一下，像我点头。
idle.en: My flame jumps once, like a nod.

look_player.en: Your iron fits you better than mine.
Are you searching for armor too?
You're much taller than I am.
My eyes are behind this visor.
That blade at your belt is so bright.
Which fire did you come from?
Don't laugh; I'm still growing.

look_player.zh: 我能摸一下你的护腕吗？
look_player.en: May I touch your gauntlet?

look_player.zh: 你身上没有烧焦的味道。
look_player.en: You don't smell of scorched wood.

look_player.zh: 站低一点，我仰得脖子酸。
look_player.en: Kneel a bit; my neck aches from looking up.

look_player.zh: 你也听见那栋屋子在响吗？
look_player.en: Do you hear that house creaking too?
My fire can't light all of you.
Have you seen anyone in red armor?
I've noted the shape of your shadow.

tempted.en: Is that charcoal? Give me a piece.
That log has burned all the way through.
I smell rust and pine resin.
Do you carry a flint?
A little fire is enough for me.
There's still warmth in that armor.
Hand me a burned branch.
I don't eat anything raw.

tempted.zh: 你把火举低点，我够不到。
tempted.en: Lower the flame; I can't reach it.
This small spark will last me a while.

collide.en: Iron meets iron with a bright ring.
I get knocked to one side.
Sorry—my armor is too wide.
You bumped me and sparks flew out.
I catch the wall and steady myself.
I'm small; I get squeezed aside easily.
Don't step on my foot; the iron dents.

collide.zh: 我退了三步，甲响个不停。
collide.en: I back three steps, armor clattering.
That knock sent a plate loose.

collide.zh: 我们离远点，我怕烫到你。
collide.en: Let's keep space; I might burn you.

mate.zh: 另一簇火，在灰堆那边。
mate.en: Another little flame is by the ash heap.

mate.zh: 她也穿着不合身的甲。
mate.en: She wears armor that doesn't fit either.

mate.zh: 我想把我的火分她一半。
mate.en: I want to share half my fire with her.

mate.zh: 两簇火靠在一起，就不冷了。
mate.en: Two flames together, and the cold leaves.

mate.zh: 我给她找了块小铁片。
mate.en: I found a small iron plate for her.

mate.zh: 她的火是橘色的，很漂亮。
mate.en: Her flame is orange, and beautiful.

mate.zh: 我们并排坐着，谁也没说话。
mate.en: We sit side by side without a word.

mate.zh: 我想以后找两副甲。
mate.en: Someday I'll find armor for two.

mate.zh: 火小的时候，就靠近一点。
mate.en: When the fire is small, we move closer.

mate.zh: 她说我烧得太旺了。
mate.en: She says I burn too brightly.

pickup.en: An iron plate—it can patch my shoulder.
I wedge it into a seam of my armor.
This nail is still warm.

pickup.zh: 一截烧焦的木头，很有用。
pickup.en: A charred stick—very useful.
Someone dropped a gauntlet.

pickup.zh: 拖不动就推，推不动就滚。
pickup.en: If I can't drag it, I'll push and roll it.
I pile my finds in the corner.
This helm is two sizes too big.
There's someone's name on it.
Holding it, my fire burns brighter.

target_acquire.zh: 我站起来，虽然只到你腰。
target_acquire.en: I stand up, though I reach only your waist.
My fire leaps up a notch.
Forty hit points, and I'll still fight.
I watch where you put your feet.
Don't think I'm slow to burn.
This house is my ground.
You stamped out my brazier.

target_acquire.zh: 我要证明我穿得动这身甲。
target_acquire.en: I'll prove I can wear this armor.
I'll be the one to strike first.
The armor's big, but I can lift it.

targeting.en: My flame is leaning forward.
You shift half a step; I shift after you.
I'll charge on the count of three.
My armor rattles, urging me on.
I aim for your knee—it's lower.
Flames crawl toward you along the ground.
Big or not, fire burns everyone the same.
When the wind drops, I move.
My hands shake—that's excitement.
This one takes everything I have.

melee_attack.en: I charge in with fire in my arms.
My iron fist hits your leg guard.
Sparks splash across your face.

melee_attack.zh: 我跳起来，只够到你的腰。
melee_attack.en: I jump, reaching only your waist.
The armor's heavy; I let it fall on you.
Flame runs up the edge of your blade.

melee_attack.zh: 我撞了一下，自己先倒了。
melee_attack.en: I charge once and fall over first.
I've practiced this punch for a long time.
A small patch of your sleeve is scorched.
I back off, panting for breath.

spawn.en: Two red points light up in the ash.
I crawl out of an old helmet.
This house burned a long time ago.
The fire comes first; the body forms after.
I shake the ash off my armor.
Smoke still hangs inside the house.
I stand up on broken tiles.
Someone built a fire nearby.
This time I'll find good armor.

spawn.zh: 我对着火盆照了照自己。
spawn.en: I check myself in the brazier's glow.
Sparks rise, then settle again.
I'm here—don't stamp out the fire.

generic.en: A plate's dented, but my fire still burns.
The blow drives me to my knees.
I can bear this much pain.
My flame wavers, but it doesn't go out.
I cover my head and duck into the corner.
A plate fell off; I pick it up.
Not the visor—it will crack.
I hold on, and my fire burns stronger.

generic.zh: 甲在响，抖的是铁，不是我。
generic.en: The armor rattles; it's the iron shaking, not me.
I'll keep this dent as a mark to remember.

fire.zh: 火烧在我身上，只是更暖。
fire.en: Fire on my body only makes me warmer.

fall.zh: 我从甲里摔出来，滚了两圈。
fall.en: I tumble out of my armor and roll twice.

drown.en: Water puts out my fire; it's so cold.

explosion.en: The blast tears my armor open.

projectile.en: An arrow sticks in my chest plate.

starvation.en: Nothing to feed on; I'm nearly out.

lightning.en: Lightning runs through my iron armor.

void.zh: 这里连火星都浮不起来。
void.en: Here not even sparks can rise.
